title: atomic-release-bundles-for-private-deployer
author: Priya Rao
description:
Motivation: private installer upgrades currently rely on monolithic release bundles which make incremental upgrades slow and fragile for air-gapped/private customers. This PR introduces an 'atomic release bundle' format and a small indexer/zipper service that emits compact delta bundles plus a signed snapshot manifest so the private installer can perform deterministic roll-forward and roll-back upgrades without pulling full images each time.

What this PR does (single-string summary): adds an indexer that composes atomic bundle shards (catalog + artifacts), emits cosign-attested snapshot manifests (attestation-v2 envelope), plumbs signed provenance metadata into the private-installer helm charts and terraform module, updates the installer upgrade controller to prefer delta bundles and fall back to full bundles, and enhances CI to build, sign, and publish both full and delta artifacts to the release storage pipeline.

Checklist: [x] indexer service + unit tests – servers/indexer/ – produces .zip shards and snapshot.manifest.json; [x] cosign signing step in release pipeline – .github/workflows/release.yml; [x] Helm chart updates for private-installer to consume snapshot manifests (values.private.bundleManifestUrl) and a new immutableUpgrade flag; [x] Terraform module bump to expose bundle retention and bucket prefix routing; [x] installer controller update to apply roll-forward/roll-back using manifest version hashes; [x] docs and upgrade notes (docs/private/atomic-bundles.md) with recommended retention policy and recovery steps.

Compatibility and security notes: cosign-friendly signing is backward-compatible with existing attestation consumers; the attestation envelope v2 includes a concise provenance pointer (origin build SHA, builder image tag, CVE-ignored list) and a KMS key ID header for rotation auditing. We added an allowlist for manifest media-types to the installer to reject unexpected payloads.

CI changes: release pipeline builds both 'full-bundle' and 'delta-bundle' artifacts across matrix {k8s:1.26,1.27} x {arch:amd64,arm64}, runs unit/integration tests inside ephemeral kind clusters for the installer controller, and triggers a cosign signing job that writes SLSA-compatible statements into the artifact store.

How to validate locally: run make indexer-local to build a sample snapshot of the chart+images, then run ./dev/installer/bin/upgrade --manifest ./out/snapshot.manifest.json --dry-run to see proposed actions.

Related: RFC-2025 (atomic-bundles), ENG-2101, SUP-1123.
